properties.digitized_from: DataSF Building Footprints (mblr SF8721010); name/address from OpenStreetMap way 28844040 (500 Terry A. Francois Blvd)
properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-19 for Mission Bay's third real-buildings pass (remaining uncovered footprints inside the official Mission Bay North/South redevelopment-area boundary): 500 Terry A. Francois Blvd (Mission Bay Block 26A), a 6-story, ~310,000 sq ft office building built by the Sobrato Organization, completed 2008; sat empty for four years before Cisco's Meraki division leased space in 2012, followed by Cisco's $1.2B acquisition of Meraki. Tenants have included Cisco and Wix.
properties.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- surveyed DataSF Building Footprints outline (mblr SF8721010), cross-referenced by position against an OpenStreetMap building/address point (way 28844040) for the name and street address; not a hand trace or plan estimate.
